purpose: Questions for visitors to ask, not answers, verified access information or booking advice. Prepared with AI assistance under Ahimanikya Satapathy’s direction.

questions.heading: Access
questions.text: Which parts of the places I want to see can I enter, and who can confirm the current visitor arrangements?

questions.heading: Getting there and back
questions.text: Where will I begin and finish my city day, and how will I get back to my base?

questions.heading: Comfort and pace
questions.text: Where can I take a seated break, and which stretches suit the people travelling with me?

questions.heading: Food and water
questions.text: Which meal would I like to make time for, and who can answer my questions about ingredients?

questions.heading: People and pictures
questions.text: Before I photograph a person or a lived-in street, have I asked whether they are comfortable with it?

questions.heading: A change of plan
questions.text: If a stop is closed or the day feels too full, which one story would I most like to keep?

questions.heading: Access
questions.text: Which part of Dhauli do I want to understand first, and where can I confirm access to that part?

questions.heading: Getting there and back
questions.text: How will I arrange a return pickup, and where will we agree to meet?

questions.heading: Comfort and pace
questions.text: What walking, slopes or steps will my intended visit involve, and is there a suitable place to pause?

questions.heading: Food and water
questions.text: Where will I arrange drinking water and a meal around the visit, without assuming they are available at the stop?

questions.heading: People and pictures
questions.text: How can I ask a guide to separate what the inscriptions say from later interpretation and local telling?

questions.heading: A change of plan
questions.text: If I cannot reach every viewpoint, what part of the story can I still spend unhurried time with?

questions.text: Where can I confirm current entry arrangements and which parts of the monument are open to visitors?

questions.heading: Getting there and back
questions.text: How will I get to Konark and return, and what meeting point will I share with my driver or companions?

questions.heading: Comfort and pace
questions.text: How much standing and walking suits our group, and where can we ask about step-free access and breaks?

questions.heading: Food and water
questions.text: Where will I plan water and a meal, and have I left time to enjoy them instead of rushing onward?

questions.heading: People and pictures
questions.text: If I choose a guide, can we agree the scope and price and ask which carvings or stories they will help us understand?

questions.heading: A change of plan
questions.text: If conditions shorten the visit, which detail would I like to study closely rather than trying to see everything?

questions.heading: Access
questions.text: Which places are open to me, and where can I confirm entry rules before shaping my day around them?

questions.heading: Getting there and back
questions.text: What are my arrival and return arrangements, and where will I meet my companions if we separate?

questions.heading: Comfort and pace
questions.text: Where can our group rest, and what quieter alternative can we choose if an area feels too crowded?

questions.heading: Food and water
questions.text: Which food experience matters to me, and who can clarify how it is obtained, served and paid for?

questions.heading: People and pictures
questions.text: Where is photography welcome, and where should I put the camera away and simply be present?

questions.heading: A change of plan
questions.text: If the weather or crowds change our plans, what indoor or quieter option can we check locally?

questions.heading: Access
questions.text: Is the workshop I hope to visit welcoming visitors that day, and should I arrange a time first?

questions.heading: Getting there and back
questions.text: How will I arrive without blocking homes or workspaces, and how will I arrange my return?

questions.heading: Comfort and pace
questions.text: How long would the maker like us to stay, and what pace lets us listen without interrupting their work?

questions.heading: Food and water
questions.text: Where will I plan refreshments separately so a workshop visit does not assume hospitality from a household?

questions.heading: People and pictures
questions.text: Before recording a person, process or artwork, have I asked permission and how they would like to be credited?

questions.heading: A change of plan
questions.text: If a maker is busy, can I return at an agreed time or choose another welcome visit without pressing them?

questions.heading: Access
questions.text: Who can explain the current arrangements for the meal I want to understand, including any entry restrictions?

questions.heading: Getting there and back
questions.text: How does the meal fit into my day, and can I reach it without compressing the rest of the visit?

questions.heading: Comfort and pace
questions.text: What serving and seating arrangements should our group ask about before deciding where to eat?

questions.heading: Food and water
questions.text: Who can answer directly about ingredients, preparation and my dietary needs before I order or accept food?

questions.heading: People and pictures
questions.text: Can I ask about the meaning of the meal respectfully, and check before photographing people or their food?

questions.heading: A change of plan
questions.text: If this meal is unavailable or unsuitable for me, what alternative can I ask about without treating it as the same tradition?

questions.heading: Access
questions.text: Can the property describe the actual room and entrance I would use, including any steps or access constraints?

questions.heading: Getting there and back
questions.text: How will I reach the property on arrival and get back after my planned visits?

questions.heading: Comfort and pace
questions.text: Can the property confirm the facilities and quiet or rest conditions that matter to our group?

questions.heading: Food and water
questions.text: What food and drinking-water arrangements are included, and which need to be arranged separately?

questions.heading: People and pictures
questions.text: Who will be my contact at the property, and what house or neighbourhood expectations should I understand?

questions.heading: A change of plan
questions.text: What are the cancellation terms and my alternative plan if the room or arrangements no longer suit us?

questions.heading: Choose the shore
questions.text: Which gateway fits the experience I want, and what is the exact meeting point?

questions.heading: Boarding and comfort
questions.text: Can everyone in our group board comfortably, and are suitable life jackets, shade and toilets available?

questions.heading: Food and water
questions.text: Where will we eat, and who can confirm ingredients, drinking water and vegetarian options?

questions.heading: Wildlife and people
questions.text: Will the operator give wildlife space, and have I asked before photographing people?

questions.heading: Return journey
questions.text: Who arranges our return to the base, and what time or transfer must we confirm?

questions.heading: Weather changes
questions.text: Who decides whether the outing runs, and what are the cancellation or alternative arrangements?
